clues: This city is the capital of a state in southern India. It sits on an east coast beside the Bay of Bengal.
Most of its rain falls in one season, brought by the north-east monsoon winds. That time of year often brings cyclones, and low ground floods under the rain.
In 1639, the British got this coast by a land grant. They built Fort Saint George, the first British fort in India.
People come from far away for care at its hospitals. Many call it the health capital of India.
This city is called the Cultural Capital of South India. It is a big centre for music, art, and dance.
